skill2: Vamp: Prevents being targeted by single-target attacks continuously. This effect is removed upon taking a direct hit.

caveats: ⚑ skill1 block A trigger: kit says the buff fires "when the stage target appears"; modeled as a passive self-applying 10s window at t=0. Whether it re-fires on boss transitions/phase changes is kit-silent and unmeasured.

⚑ skill1 block B is gated on the unit being in Vamp status (granted by skill2 on Full Burst entry, lost on a direct hit). The schema has no self-status gate (requiresTargetStatus is boss-scoped), so this is proxied with fbGate:'inFb' — CONSERVATIVE: real Vamp persists after the FB window until a direct hit, so the model under-credits post-FB stacking. Do not treat the proxy as the measured mechanic.

⚑ The self stacks (4.4% Sustained Damage / 1.84% Hit Rate, cap 10, 10s) are modeled as per-trigger-pull accrual via shotFired; the kit says only "when attacking", so pellets-vs-pulls accrual is unmeasured. With 9 rounds/magazine the cap is only reachable inside a single FB window if the accrual is per pull and no reload intervenes.

⚑ Total Hit Rate on this unit is large (21.96 continuous + 11.13 team-wide opener + up to 18.4 stacked). The Hit-Rate→core conversion magnitude is engine-derived and unmeasured for this unit — it is the single biggest lever on her modeled damage.

⚑ DEF ▼ 19.83% is authored as an enemy-targeted buff with stat 'defPct' and a NEGATIVE value; the sign/stat convention for boss DEF reduction was not verifiable from the schema comments (which describe defPct in its self/Endurance-cube role). If the engine expects a different channel, this line is wrong in encoding, not in magnitude.
The burst's Sustained Damage DoT is boosted by this unit's own skill1 Sustained Damage stacks — the two lines are coupled, so a stack-model error propagates into burst damage.

DoT append-not-refresh: each burst cast appends an independent 10s instance. With a 20s burst cooldown, instances should not overlap; if measured rotation lets her burst faster, verify no double-counting.
noFb is deliberately NOT set anywhere (default FB-by-timing ON, measured-only). The burst-cast instant hit is FB-exempt by cast timing, not by an override flag.
Weapon cadence (9 ammo, 122 reload frames, 10 pellets/shot) comes from the datamine and is unreliable per the standing prior; it was not adjusted here.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Viper (SG/Water/Attacker/Burst II) is modeled as: (skill1) a fight-open 10s team ATK+Hit-Rate window, plus a self-stacking Sustained-Damage/Hit-Rate ramp gated on Vamp status (proxied by fbGate:'inFb' — no self-status primitive exists); (skill2) a continuous self Hit-Rate passive and a rotation effect — her burst re-enters Burst Stage 2, letting a second Burst II ally cast in the same chain; (burst) a 1029.6% single-target nuke, a 10s boss DEF ▼, and a 10s 105.3%/sec Sustained DoT that her own skill1 stacks amplify. Defensive Vamp untargetability and the 1s invulnerability are deliberately unmodeled (no boss damage in v1) — but Vamp is NOT inert in principle: it is the enabling condition for the skill1 stack block, which is why that block carries a proxy gate rather than being skipped. The rotation-facing reenterStage effect is the highest-leverage line in this override and is the first thing to verify against a rotation log.

flags.estimate: passive block + durationSec 10 on each buff ⇒ a single 10s team window starting at t=0
flags.reasoning: "Activates when the stage target appears" has no matching TriggerDef. The stage target appears once, at fight start, so a passive block whose buffs carry a 10s duration reproduces the observable window. Risk: if the engine treats a passive block's buffs as permanently re-applied, this becomes a whole-fight team ATK+Hit-Rate buff — a large over-credit.
flags.recipe: Run controlComp('viper') with cfg.onEvent capturing buffApply for stat 'atkPct' value 25.98 and read expiresFrame; assert exactly one application at frame 0 and expiry at frame 600. If it re-applies or never expires, re-key. Then check footage for a second application at a boss transition.

flags.estimate: 'inFb' as a proxy for Vamp status
flags.reasoning: Vamp is granted on Full Burst entry and is 'continuous' until a direct hit; with no boss damage modeled it would in reality persist for the rest of the fight after the first FB. The schema's only status gate (requiresTargetStatus) is boss-scoped, so there is no way to express a self-status that turns on at FB entry and never turns off. 'inFb' under-credits (shots between FBs stop stacking); ungated would over-credit (stacks from t=0, before Vamp exists).
flags.recipe: Read popup damage on a recorded fight: compare her per-shot damage in the seconds immediately AFTER a Full Burst window closes against the same shots before her first FB. If post-FB shots stay elevated, Vamp persists and the correct model is a latching gate (first-FB onward), not 'inFb'.

flags.estimate: 1 stack per trigger pull (shotFired), cap 10, 10s rolling
flags.reasoning: "When attacking" is ambiguous for a shotgun: 10 pellets land per pull, so a per-HIT reading would cap the stacks on the very first shot while a per-PULL reading needs 10 pulls (more than one 9-round magazine). The two readings differ by roughly a full magazine of ramp, which is material inside a 10s FB window.
flags.recipe: Count buffApply events for stat 'sustainedDamagePct' key over one magazine in a harness run; cross-check against footage by watching how many shots it takes for her Sustained DoT tick value to plateau after a burst.

flags.estimate: Hit Rate total up to ~51.5% (21.96 continuous + 11.13 opener + 1.84×10); core-lift magnitude unknown
flags.reasoning: Hit-Rate→core conversion is an engine-derived ⚑ per standing rule, and this unit stacks more Hit Rate than most. As a shotgun with 10 pellets per shot, the core-rate lift is the dominant term in her normal-attack damage — an error here swamps every other line in this override.
flags.recipe: Compare a run with HRCORE=0 against the default in the same process-free A/B (separate processes — the env table is read once at import) and report the delta; then validate against a recorded fight's core-hit popup fraction for her shots.

flags.reasoning: The StatKey list documents defPct only in its self/Endurance-cube (inert) role and offers damageTakenPct as the explicit boss debuff. A boss DEF reduction is mechanically distinct from Damage Taken ▲ (it enters the formula's DEF subtraction, not the Damage Up bucket), so encoding it as damageTakenPct would be wrong even if it happened to move damage. The sign convention for a ▼ on an enemy target is unverified.
flags.recipe: Grep the committed overrides for an existing 'DEF ▼' carrier and match its encoding exactly; confirm with a harness run that buffApply fires with casterIdx===null && targetIdx===null (the boss-held-debuff signature) and that total damage rises, not falls.

flags.estimate: 9 ammo / 122 reload frames / 10 pellets per shot, fire rate not stated
flags.reasoning: Datamined rate_of_fire and reloadFrames are the known-unreliable fields; effective cadence is quantized to 60fps frame boundaries so the nominal value is not the shots/sec the sim should use. Shot count drives both her stack ramp and her total normal damage.
flags.recipe: Read shots/sec directly off the ammo counter in a recorded fight (the instrument that measures the disputed quantity) rather than inferring it from full-burst counts.
